description:
## Summary
Port the `/session` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
Running `/session` in the upstream pi renders a read-only info panel for the current session. Fields shown (zero-value cache fields are omitted):

```
  File:     /home/user/.pi/sessions/abc123.json
  ID:       abc123
  Messages: 12 (3 user, 9 assistant)
  Tokens:   ↑ 4821  ↓ 1203  R 0  W 512
  Cost:     $0.0041
```

Rendering rules:
- Labels use `theme.fg("dim", ...)`
- Values are plain (no color)
- Cache-read and cache-write token counts are omitted when 0
- Cost line only appears when total cost > 0
- Displayed inside the same DynamicBorder+Spacer chrome as other overlays
- Press Escape to dismiss

## Source References
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 5050 `handleSessionCommand()`
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"session"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"session"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/session` dispatch clause
3. Implement handler that reads current session state (file path, ID, message counts, token usage, cost)
4. Render as: border-framed overlay with dim labels, omitting zero cache fields and cost when 0
5. Escape dismisses the overlay

## Note
octo_pi currently has a `/sessions` command (plural). Upstream has `/session` (singular, shows current session info) and `/resume` (the session picker). Confirm whether `/sessions` should be renamed or deprecated.
title: Port /session command
